nodes.label: Phase 0 — Foundation
nodes.rationale: Container-first removed the OCCT bundling gate, so this is no longer a go/no-go risk. Exit: podman compose up on a clean machine serves a page and occt-bridge converts a 200-part STEP assembly in under 30 s. Verify pgvector and the Turkish snowball config here, not later.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Ingest And Grid
nodes.rationale: Blob CAS, the Postgres job queue, mesh ingest to thumbnail plus L0, virtualized grid, SSE progress, download original, and a bundled licence-clean example part so the first grid is never empty.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Exit Measurement, 2026-09-07
nodes.rationale: 1,095 real STLs / 15.67 GB in 130.3 s; re-drop 40.1 s with 0 re-ingested; grid 5.3 ms median at page size 50. The fourth clause failed: one 635,470-triangle file clustered to nothing and MeshKernel::process used ?, so an unmakeable derivative was indistinguishable from an unreadable file and no part row was written. Fixed so parsing stays fatal but a failed derivative lands in KernelOutput::unproduced. The measurement also corrected its own diagnosis — CadError::Unrenderable is raised by both the rasterizer and the glTF writer, so a tessellation_l0 failure was written up as a thumbnail failure.

nodes.label: Phase 2 — CAD Ingest And Search
nodes.rationale: STEP and IGES through the sidecar, extraction stages 1-4, dual search and facets. Exit: a mixed folder ingests with no manual steps and the fragment 1234 returns A1234-56-B at position one.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Viewer And Measurement
nodes.rationale: Exit: measure a known cylinder from STEP and get the exact nominal diameter, not a tessellated approximation, with part open to first paint under 120 ms warm.

nodes.label: Phase 4 — Versioning, Agent, Round-Trip
nodes.rationale: This phase is the differentiator; everything before it is a file browser. Exit: open a STEP in FreeCAD, change it, save, and a new revision appears with a correct volume delta on Linux, macOS and Windows. Three-step deletion landed early in Phase 1 slice 7 on the owner's call — a library you could add to and never remove from was the more pressing gap — leaving tiering here, because tiering is what makes quarantine's physical layout matter.

nodes.label: Phase 5 — Source Links, Bundles, Collections
nodes.rationale: Exit: paste a Printables URL and get title, licence and a cached image; export a 40-part assembly another user can import with lineage intact.

nodes.label: Phase 6 — Dashboard And Similarity
nodes.rationale: Exit: a 12-widget dashboard settles in one round trip and uploading a known part surfaces its near-duplicates.

nodes.label: Phase 7 — Build Graph
nodes.rationale: Do not start early: a half-working planner attached to a good browser makes the whole app feel unfinished. Exit: a three-level assembly, a run of 4 units, correct quantities in the queue, followed to completion on a phone.

nodes.label: Phase 8 — Enterprise And Fleet
nodes.rationale: Exit: register three remote workers, process a 500-part library across the fleet, revoke one mid-run and watch its leases expire and requeue cleanly.

nodes.label: Phase 9 — Cloud
nodes.rationale: Only after the local product has users. Zero-egress object storage on day one, not as an optimization; per-tenant dedup only, never cross-tenant; egress instrumented per tenant from the first beta day; a lapsed subscription goes read-only with full download, never deletion.

nodes.label: Phase 10 — Tauri Shell
nodes.rationale: Three connection modes, embedded never built. Bundles only our own binaries — if you are tempted to bundle Postgres or OCCT, stop.

nodes.label: Meter Per Worker Node, Not Per Seat
nodes.rationale: Distributed compute is inherently multi-machine, so a hobbyist on one laptop loses nothing while a shop with eight workstations gets real value — near-perfect price/value alignment with zero crippling of the free app. Seats are annoying to administer, easy to fudge and resented; worker count is a hard number the coordinator already knows and drops into max_workers in an offline signed licence. Grace period, never a hard stop: a customer whose line halts over a lapsed licence will not renew, and will tell people.

nodes.label: Two Payment Rails, Both Required
nodes.rationale: MoR for cloud and small card purchases, and invoice plus purchase order plus e-fatura plus wire — a EUR 5,000 self-hosted licence does not go through a checkout page. That second rail is where the highest-value customers live and is the one solo developers forget to build.

nodes.label: Law 4691 Technology Development Zone Exemption
nodes.rationale: Erciyes Teknopark earnings from in-zone software and R&D are exempt from income and corporate tax until 31/12/2028 with matching VAT relief. Conditions are strict (munhasiran, management-company approval, a qualified-expenditure ratio, a 2% VC contribution above 1M TL). Plausibly worth more in year one than any pricing decision, and some of it depends on day-one entity structure — take it to a mali musavir before incorporating.

nodes.label: Roadmap Open Items
nodes.rationale: Trademark clearance for a common English word, pgvector and Turkish tsvector against postgres:18, measuring the zstd dictionary gain on a real STEP corpus before committing, MoR Turkey payout support, and WebKitGTK variance across Linux distros.
